errors.text_span: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of categories within the FineWeb-Edu Classifier clustering results.
errors.evidence: The figure actually shows TWO pie charts side by side: one for AttentionInfluence (left) and one for FineWeb-Edu Classifier (right). The description only addresses one of them, ignoring the AttentionInfluence chart entirely.

The description completely omits the left pie chart (AttentionInfluence), which is an equal part of the figure. The generation prompt asks to describe what is shown in the chart, and the figure contains two charts.
The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart labels Health & Medicine as 19, not 22. 22 appears in the AttentionInfluence chart.
Education 38 appears in the interior/inner ring label area, not as a yellow segment. The color mapping described as yellow does not accurately represent what is shown.

Counting the visible segments in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart: Teaching & resources, Healthy education, Science & technology education, Diseases, Nutrition, Medical, Animal & Plant, Materials, Health & Medicine, Science, Historical review, History & Society, Materials, Society & culture, Events & people, Infor tech, Emerging tech, Tech & Engineer, Manage, and a truncated segment — the count appears to be around 20, and there's also an unlabeled/truncated segment. The exact count of 21 is questionable.

The label 'Fin & Engineer' (Fin & Law 3) appears in the AttentionInfluence chart, not in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart. The FineWeb-Edu Classifier has a truncated label that appears to be 'Tech & Eng...' not 'Fin & Engineer'.
This is correct per the label (19), but the color description as 'cyan' is inaccurate — this segment appears teal/green in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart.

The description does not mention that the numbers shown in the chart labels appear to be raw counts (not percentages), as the values like 38, 19, 17, etc. are labeled directly in the segments and do not add up to 100 as percentages.
The FineWeb-Edu Classifier labels Historical review as 12, so it should be approximately 12, not a range of 7-12.
